facts.fact: Eswatini launched the She Powers Africa Digital Academy, which begins with 50 women from government and government-related institutions trained in AI, cybersecurity, data science, software development and IT operations, delivered by the UAE's General Women's Union with TDRA and the Digital Government Academy.

systems.owner: UAE General Women's Union with TDRA

facts.fact: The ICT minister said Coders Eswatini, implemented through cooperation with the UAE, aims to equip 300,000 emaSwati with internationally recognised digital skills, at least half women.
